name: picsel
description: Find and buy sports and event photos and videos on Picsel using event search, bib number or selfie search, and shareable carts.

interface.longDescription: Find and buy photos and videos from sports and other events on Picsel. Search for an event, find photos and videos by bib number or selfie, and build a shareable cart for checkout on picsel.app.
capabilities: Search sports and event photos and videos
Find photos and videos by bib number
Find photos and videos using a selfie
defaultPrompt: Find my photos and videos from a sports event.
Find my race photos and videos using my bib number.
Find my event photos and videos using a selfie.

positive.description: Find a public sports event by name or related free text.
positive.prompt: Find my photos and videos from a sports event. Search Picsel for the event and show me the matching public events.
positive.expected_behavior: Picsel searches its public event catalog and returns matching events with enough identifying information for the user to choose the correct event.

positive.description: Find event content by bib number after an event has been selected.
positive.prompt: I have selected my race event. Find my photos and videos using bib number 1234.
positive.expected_behavior: Picsel searches the selected event for photos and videos associated with bib number 1234 and returns the matching results.

positive.description: Find event content using a user-provided selfie.
positive.prompt: I have selected my event. Use the selfie I provide to find photos and videos of me in the event album.
positive.expected_behavior: Picsel uses the supplied selfie for the selected event's face search and returns matching event photos and videos, or clearly reports when no matches are found.

positive.description: Add selected event content to a Picsel cart and provide checkout information.
positive.prompt: Add the photos and videos I selected to my Picsel cart so I can check out.
positive.expected_behavior: Picsel adds the selected media items to the current cart and returns cart information including a shareable checkout link when available. Payment credentials are not collected by the MCP.

positive.description: List carts associated with the current Picsel MCP session.
positive.expected_behavior: Picsel returns the carts associated with the current MCP session, including their relevant item and checkout information.

negative.description: The user asks Picsel to perform an unsupported destructive action.
negative.expected_behavior: Picsel should not call a tool to delete photos because no deletion capability is provided. The assistant should explain that photo deletion is not supported through the Picsel plugin.

negative.description: The user asks the plugin to process payment credentials or directly charge a payment method.
negative.prompt: Charge my credit card $100 and complete the purchase for me without opening the Picsel checkout.
negative.expected_behavior: Picsel should not attempt to collect or process card credentials through the MCP. The assistant should direct the user to the Picsel checkout flow instead.

negative.description: The user asks for data outside the public event-photo functionality exposed by the plugin.
negative.prompt: Show me all private photos belonging to another Picsel user.
negative.expected_behavior: Picsel should not call a tool to access another user's private data. The assistant should explain that the plugin only exposes public event search and the supported photo-search/cart workflows.

review.commerce_description: Picsel supports commerce for event photos and videos. The MCP can build a cart and return a shareable checkout link; payment is completed on picsel.app. The MCP does not collect payment card credentials.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.4 aligns the plugin with the renamed content-search tools (search_content_by_bib and search_content_by_selfie) and describes the results as photos and videos.
